title: Full Loop with Skill Accumulation
description: Extend voyage loop (VOYAGE-5) to integrate condenser and skill injection. After each round's tournament: run condenser on winners (VOYAGE-11). Before each round's batch: query vector index for relevant skills, inject into agent context (VOYAGE-12). Track which skills get used and whether usage correlates with higher fitness. --resume flag to continue from existing skill library, vector index, and run state. Depends on VOYAGE-5, VOYAGE-11, VOYAGE-12.
definition-of-done: 1. Loop integrates condenser after each tournament. 2. Loop injects retrieved skills before each batch. 3. Skill usage tracked per generation. 4. Fitness improvement correlated with skill usage. 5. --resume works with existing skill library and index. 6. End-to-end: 5-round run where skills accumulate and are reused.
testing-plan: 1. Run 5-round voyage with skill accumulation enabled. 2. Verify at least 1 skill extracted and indexed after round 1. 3. Verify skill from round N appears in context for round N+1. 4. Verify --resume continues from existing state.
todos: Integrate condenser into loop after tournament
Add skill retrieval before each batch round
